overall: The AG found no violation: because the full notices made clear an open meeting would occur, the Board did not have to list "Open Session" before its executive session items. The AG suggested listing "Call to Order" or "Open Session" first, and noted the Board had already adopted that practice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the September 19 and September 26 meeting notices failed to list an open session before the executive session topics.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board was not required to list "Open Session" in its meeting notices, and did not violate the Open Meeting Law by omitting this statement.
